verified_fact: One legend says a hunter named Lubdhaka accidentally kept vigil all night in a Bel tree above a Shiva linga (unknown to him), dropping Bel leaves on it. Shiva was pleased by the unintentional worship and blessed him. This night became Mahashivaratri.
voiceover_script: Mahashivaratri ki ek kahani hai — ek shikaari Lubdhaka ki. Jungle mein raat ko bhaag ke ek Bel ke ped par chadha. Poori raat jaagta raha darte darte. Ped ke neeche tha ek Shivalinga — use pata nahi tha. Haath se Bel ke patte gir rahe the — shivling par. Unjaane mein poori raat shiv pooja ho gayi! Shiv ne use mukti di. Ye raat ban gayi Mahashivaratri!
debate_question: Kya jaane anjane mein bhi bhakti hoti hai?
pinned_comment: 🙏 Anjane mein pooja — Shiv ne phir bhi mukti di! Har Har Mahadev!

Mahashivaratri Kyun Manate Hain? Asli Story! 🙏

🔱 Mahashivratri origin story hunter Lubdhaka Shiva blessing

One legend says a hunter named Lubdhaka accidentally kept vigil all night in a Bel tree above a Shiva linga (unknown to him), dropping Bel leaves on it. Shiva was pleased by the unintentional worship and blessed him. This night became Mahashivaratri.

👉 Kya jaane anjane mein bhi bhakti hoti hai?
